infra_make.description: Modular build matrix rules for Vulkan, SYCL, OpenVINO, and LiteRT
infra_make.assessment: Strong build modularity, but sub-makefiles lacked explicit PROJECT_ROOT dynamic anchoring.

tools.description: Automation scripts for build execution, testing, telemetry, and ascii parsing
tools.assessment: Effective python wrappers using uv proxy; candidate for direct porting into edge-ai/tools/.

fekerr_dev.description: PowerShell 7 host toolkit and container bootstrap stratum
fekerr_dev.assessment: Windows host environment bootstrapper; useful reference for WSL2 environment setup.

ai_io.description: Input/output data processing layer for local model interaction

logs_and_telemetry.description: Persistent build journals and structured test metrics datastores
logs_and_telemetry.assessment: Rich historical dataset; non-standard timestamp format (`20260718_logs_core12_1003.zip`).
